The legislation granted the institute formal autonomy, making it the first institution in India empowered to award its own degrees in fashion education. Statutory Status: Enacted on 13 July 2006, and brought into effect on 1 April 2007. Academic Power: It empowers NIFT to grant degrees and other academic distinctions. Governance: It outlines the framework for a Board of Governors and the Senate to steer the institution, with the President of India serving as the 'Visitor'.
